kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
تأسلمت (form IIq)
# تَأَسْلَمْتُ (taʔaslamtu) /ta.ʔas.lam.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَأَسْلَمَ (taʔaslama)
# تَأَسْلَمْتَ (taʔaslamta) /ta.ʔas.lam.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَأَسْلَمَ (taʔaslama)
# تَأَسْلَمْتِ (taʔaslamti) /ta.ʔas.lam.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَأَسْلَمَ (taʔaslama)
# تَأَسْلَمَتْ (taʔaslamat) /ta.ʔas.la.mat/: t
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
